integrity: A self-contained proof and independently replayable finite checker are supplied; finite tests are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact universal cutoff only for finite transitive Kripke frames and blocks of consecutive non-contingency operators; no statement of an analogous cardinality-free bound for infinite transitive frames. Older algebraic presentations remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp stabilization index for iterated non-contingency on finite transitive frames
